templates.title: Templates and series
templates.intro: Save your post formats, hashtag groups and go-to texts. A template can schedule a whole series: it creates drafts, and nothing is approved or published on its own.
templates.notConfigured: Templates aren't active in this workspace yet (setup pending).
templates.readOnly: You have read-only access: you can view templates but not create or use them.
templates.emptyBody: Create one here, or open a post and click “Save as template”.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete the template “{name}”? Posts already created won't change.
card.hashtags: {count, plural, =0 {No hashtags} one {# hashtag} other {# hashtags}}

form.description: Base text, hashtags, accounts and preferred time. Media isn't saved in the template.
form.name: Name
form.caption: Base text
form.captionPlaceholder: Today it's '{topic}'. Will you try it this weekend?
form.captionHint: Use placeholders in braces, e.g. '{topic}': you fill them in when using the template or creating a series.
form.hashtagsHint: Separated by spaces or commas. Added at the end of the text.
form.noAccounts: Connect accounts in this project to include them in the template.
form.tiktokNote: Per TikTok's rules, its privacy, interaction and commercial content settings aren't saved: you choose them on every post.
form.youtubeNote: {count, plural, one {# YouTube option saved} other {# YouTube options saved}}. To change them, save the template again from the editor.
form.timeHint: Optional. Suggested when using the template and used for series (Madrid time).

snippets.intro: Named sets you insert in the editor with one click.
snippets.emptyHashtags: Save your usual hashtags, e.g. “Coffee hashtags”.
snippets.emptyTexts: Save calls to action or sign-offs, e.g. “Shop CTA”.
snippets.hashtagCount: {count, plural, =0 {No valid hashtags} one {# hashtag} other {# hashtags}}
snippets.overInstagram: More than 30: Instagram won't publish captions with more than 30 hashtags.
snippets.dialogHashtagsBody: Separate them with spaces or commas; we add the # if it's missing.
snippets.dialogTextBody: A text you repeat often: a call to action, a sign-off, a notice.
snippets.name: Name
snippets.contentPlaceholderText: Order it in the shop: link in bio.

series.title: Series from “{name}”
series.description: Schedule several posts with the same template. Review the dates before creating them.
series.approvalNote: A series only creates drafts or posts pending approval. Nothing is approved or published on its own: each one needs an admin's click.
series.name: Series name
series.tz: Madrid time (Europe/Madrid), daylight saving changes included.
series.valuesHint: One per line, in order: line 1 goes to post 1. If any are missing, the placeholder stays for you to fill in each draft.
series.modeDraftHint: You review them, add media and submit them yourself.
series.modePendingHint: They go to the approval queue if they already meet each network's rules; otherwise they stay as drafts.
series.noAccountsWarn: This template has no accounts: drafts will be created without a destination.
series.skippedPast: {count, plural, one {# past date was skipped} other {# past dates were skipped}}.
series.fewer: Only {count} dates fit in the next year.
series.pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {None will go to approval yet.} one {# will go to the approval queue.} other {# will go to the approval queue.}}

issues.duplicate_caption: same text on 3 or more accounts
issues.tiktok_media_required: TikTok needs a video or photos
issues.instagram_media_required: Instagram needs an image or video

series.create: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to create} one {Create # post} other {Create # posts}}
series.created: {count, plural, one {# post created} other {# posts created}}{pending, plural, =0 {} other {, # pending approval}}.

seriesList.empty: You haven't created any series yet. Open a template and click “Create series”.
seriesList.deleteConfirm: Delete the drafts and pending posts of “{name}”? Approved ones are kept.
seriesList.deleted: {deleted} deleted. {kept} already approved or published are kept.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
errors.not_found: It doesn't exist or was already deleted.
errors.duplicate_name: There's already one with that name in this project.
errors.not_configured: Templates aren't active in this workspace yet (setup pending).
errors.all_blocked: Every date exceeds some account's daily limit. Change the time or days.
errors.no_dates: No future dates with these settings.

editor.replaceConfirm: The title, text, accounts and their options will be replaced with the template's. Media is kept. Continue?
editor.saveBody: Saves the title, text, trailing hashtags, accounts and YouTube options. Media isn't saved.
editor.tiktokNote: Per TikTok's rules, its privacy, interaction and commercial content settings aren't saved: you choose them on every post.
editor.placeholdersBody: They're replaced in the title, text and YouTube titles. You can't submit for approval with unfilled placeholders.
